title: Identity user lifecycle event (v1)
description: Business/integration event published by identity-service (via the transactional outbox) to aegis.identity.user, keyed by userId. Consumed by outbound provisioning (SCIM), cache invalidation, and welcome flows. Carries NO credential material.
x-delivery: at-least-once via TRANSACTIONAL OUTBOX (no correctness floor — the event MUST be delivered); consumers MUST be idempotent
x-note: Published from identity-service's outbox_event table (written in the same DB transaction as the user mutation) by OutboxRelay, so the event cannot be lost between the DB commit and the Kafka publish.
